summary: Trusted V4 verification failed (exit 2); candidate retained as WIP. V4-01 candidate is coherent but cannot be accepted: trusted verification FAILED (exit 2, TRUSTED_37782502124.md) because `npm run typecheck` reports 9 TypeScript errors in the two newly added test files, so the mandatory acceptance bullet 'typecheck/tests verts' is not met. Independent checks confirm the product source typechecks cleanly, all 526 jest tests pass at runtime (including 89 in the three V4-01 suites) and the static privacy contract passes, but the test files must be type-corrected (AttachmentInput literal kind, memberIdentityKind undefined argument, overload output shape assertions, Omit<ContributionEntry,'id'> cast) before V4-01 can be accepted. No mathematical, privacy, architecture or V3-regression defect was found: zero-sum contribution/money invariants hold with the new snapshoted custom split, delta and replay balances match, categories are never seeded, named vs linked members stay distinct, attachments stay provider-agnostic and operational-only, Todo task|expense completion is atomic per kind, and history is never reinterpreted. Decision: repair — keep the candidate as WIP baseline and fix the type-level test defects only.
checks: trusted V4 verification: FAIL exit 2; see reports/audits/TRUSTED_37782502124.md

findings.problem: Typecheck fails with 5 TypeScript errors, so `npm run check` (typecheck && test) exits 2 and the acceptance bullet 'typecheck/tests verts' fails. Line 264 passes `{ userId: undefined }` to `memberIdentityKind`, whose parameter type is `Pick<Member, 'userId'>` = `string | null` (undefined not assignable). Lines 634, 636, 641 and 642 build attachment literals from a `base` object whose `kind` property widens to `string`, which is not assignable to `AttachmentInput.kind: "photo"`.
findings.evidence: TRUSTED_37782502124.md and independent `npx tsc --noEmit`: `v4-01-domain.test.ts(264,33): error TS2322: Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string | null'`; `(634,35)/(636,24)/(641,35)/(642,35): error TS2345 ... Types of property 'kind' are incompatible. Type 'string' is not assignable to type '"photo"'`. The suite itself passes at runtime (`npx jest __tests__/domain/v4-01-domain.test.ts` → PASS), so this is purely a type-level defect in the new test file; `src/` produces no tsc errors.
findings.requiredFix: Keep the assertions but make them type-correct: annotate the attachment fixture as `const base: Pick<AttachmentInput, 'id' | 'kind' | 'createdAt'> = { id: 'att-1', kind: 'photo', createdAt: ... }` (or use `kind: 'photo' as const`) so the literal keeps its narrow type; for line 264 either widen the accepted parameter of `memberIdentityKind`/`isNamedMember`/`isLinkedMember` to `string | null | undefined` (the implementation already classifies undefined as named) or construct the argument as a value typed `Pick<Member, 'userId'>` without an out-of-type `undefined`. No product behaviour change is required. Re-run `npm run check` until exit 0.
findings.verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 0 errors in this file and `npx jest __tests__/domain/v4-01-domain.test.ts` stays green (all existing assertions preserved).

findings.problem: Typecheck fails with 4 TypeScript errors in the new atomic Todo suite. Line 112 reads `result.expenseEntry` on the object returned by the `CompletionInput` overload (`TaskCompletionOutput`, which has no `expenseEntry`); line 137 reads `result.contributionEntry` on `ExpenseCompletionOutput` (which has no `contributionEntry`). Line 345 casts `Omit<ContributionEntry, 'id'>` to `{ id: string }`, which neither overlaps nor carries the required ledger fields (TS2740 + TS2352).
findings.evidence: TRUSTED_37782502124.md and independent `npx tsc --noEmit`: `v4-01-todo-atomic.test.ts(112,19): error TS2339: Property 'expenseEntry' does not exist on type 'TaskCompletionOutput'`; `(137,19): Property 'contributionEntry' does not exist on type 'ExpenseCompletionOutput'`; `(345,8): error TS2740 ... missing ... householdId, label, performedByMemberId, beneficiaryMemberIds ...` and `error TS2352: Conversion of type 'Omit<ContributionEntry, "id">' to type '{ id: string; }' ...`. Runtime suite passes (`PASS __tests__/domain/v4-01-todo-atomic.test.ts`), so the atomicity/zero-sum behaviour itself is sound; only the types are wrong.
findings.requiredFix: Make the cross-kind absence assertions type-safe without weakening them: assert with an in-check or a narrow cast, e.g. `expect('expenseEntry' in result).toBe(false)` / `expect((result as { expenseEntry?: unknown }).expenseEntry).toBeUndefined()` (and symmetrically for `contributionEntry`), instead of reading a property that the resolved overload type does not declare. For line 345, materialise a real entry id rather than an unsafe cast, e.g. `calculateContributionBalances([{ ...entry, id: 'c-plan' }], 'minutes', [], ['a', 'b'])`, or cast through `unknown` to `ContributionEntry`. Re-run `npm run check` until exit 0.
findings.verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 0 errors in this file while the runtime assertions (one-entry-per-completion, rollback/retry, zero-sum per kind) remain executed and green.

Categories therefore do not yet participate in delta-only multi-device sync.
